svg.title: First-order orbit-response error versus corrector input scale
svg.desc: Horizontal and vertical detector-orbit response residuals versus normalized active-corrector RMS input radius. Curves show mean trial RMSE, upper whiskers show maximum trial RMSE, and crosses mark incomplete exact-reference samples.

g.text: First-order orbit-response error versus corrector input scale
CESR RF-on closed orbit; 600 random directions per input scale; rho = 1 corresponds to 5 microrad active-corrector RMS
Markers and lines: mean over trials; one-sided whiskers: maximum over trials.
